# F3 lines set to show always (1.21.9 and later), fix/f3pin149. Run at 1920x1080 (GUI scale 3 = 640x360, GUI scale 4 =
# 480x270, which is the Auto GUI scale at this size) on 1.21.11 and on 26.3. The branch, then the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/f3pin149 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/f3pin149.txt -f size=1920x1080
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/f3pin149 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=b33df2c9 -f script=.github/checks/f3pin149.txt -f size=1920x1080
# and the same two with -f version=26.3. b33df2c9 is main plus this branch's test hook commit alone ("debug pin"), so
# the old pictures have the lines pinned too. With -f mod_ref=main instead, "debug pin ..." only closes F3 and pins
# nothing: main's pictures then show the HUD with no debug lines at all, which only checks parts 0, 2 and 6.
# "debug pin <line>" sets one of F3's lines to show always, as the debug options screen (F3 + F6) does (its Performance
# profile does it for "fps"); "debug unpin <line>" puts it back as a new player has it. The world is creative, so a
# bottom bar sits 50 above the bottom.
# These test games run slowly (1.21.11 at about 4 frames a second, 26.3 at 5 to 13). Before 038d36c3 and 39e1c7f4 the
# branch lost the pinned lines, and the card lost the bar's place, on about every other frame at 4 a second, so the bar
# and the cards slid between two places and a picture caught them anywhere between (the first 1.21.11 run, gh143). Now
# each should sit still where it belongs; on the old code the cards may still be caught between two places.
# The top bar steps aside for its widest size (with a long line), as the bottom bar does under F3, so it can move for a
# line its current, shorter pill doesn't touch. On 26.3, F3's text is drawn at half the Auto GUI scale (its "Debug GUI
# scale" default: 2 at 1920x1080), smaller than the HUD at GUI scale 3 and 4, but the mod measures it at the HUD's
# scale, so there the bar and the cards stop further below the lines than they need to (a known gap, both versions'
# F3 measuring; at GUI scale 2 the two scales are the same).
#
# 0. f3p-f3-bottom: nothing pinned, F3 open, bottom bar at GUI scale 3: the bar shows under F3's text, on both
#    (unchanged; as edges144's e144-f3-text).
# 1. f3p-card-tl-fps: the FPS line pinned, Record card top left, GUI scale 2 (960x540, where even the top bar's widest
#    size ends right of the card, which stays in its corner): branch: the card a few pixels lower than its corner,
#    the FPS line's grey box above it, apart; old: the line's grey box over the card's top edge.
#    f3p-card-tl-fps-gui3: the same at GUI scale 3, where the top bar's widest size reaches the card's column: on both
#    the card sits below the bar, clear of the FPS line (on the old code possibly caught between there and its corner).
# 2. f3p-card-tl-f3: F3 open: no card on both (unchanged: a top card hides for the full F3 screen).
# 3. Top bar.
#    f3p-bar-gui4-fps (480x270, FPS line only): the line ends just left of the clock; branch: the bar a little lower,
#      as its widest size would reach the line; old: at its usual place.
#    f3p-bar-pos (GUI 3, the position lines pinned too, down to about 64 on the left): branch: the bar below them (its
#      widest size reaches the XYZ and Facing lines); old: at its usual place, the lines ending left of its clock.
# 4. The system lines pinned too (Java, CPU, Display, the GPU, its driver: five rows down the right side).
#    f3p-bar-specs: branch: the bar below the lines of both sides; old: the CPU line over its stats.
#    f3p-card-tr-specs: Record card top right as well: branch: the bar as in f3p-bar-specs and the card below it, both
#      clear of the lines (on 1.21.11 this one stayed under the lines in the first run); old: the card under the lines.
# 5. Many lines pinned (about F3's whole text, with F3 closed).
#    f3p-many-top (GUI 3, top bar and top left card): branch: no card, and no bar unless the lines its width reaches
#      end within the top third (120 down); old: both, with the lines over them.
#    f3p-many-bottom-gui3 (bottom bar, 640x360): the bar shows on both if the lines end above it (about 290 down).
#    f3p-many-bottom-720 (1280x720 at GUI 3 = 426x240, the bar's top about 170 down): branch: no bar where the left
#      column reaches it; old: the lines over the bar. If the old picture shows the lines ending above the bar, this
#      case was not real at that size.
# 6. f3p-unpinned: every line back as a new player has it, F3 closed: the top bar at its usual place, no lines (both).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout LINES
resize 1920x1080
guiscale 3
look 0 -20
sleep 8
music pause
sleep 1
seek 25.5
sleep 2

# 0. F3 open, bottom bar, nothing pinned
set barPosition BOTTOM
debug on
sleep 3
shot f3p-f3-bottom
debug off
set barPosition TOP
sleep 2

# 1. Top left card and the FPS line, at GUI scale 2 and 3
set recordCard true
set cardCorner TOP_LEFT
debug pin fps
guiscale 2
sleep 3
shot f3p-card-tl-fps
guiscale 3
sleep 3
shot f3p-card-tl-fps-gui3

# 2. The same with F3 open
debug on
sleep 2
shot f3p-card-tl-f3
debug off
set recordCard false
sleep 2

# 3. Top bar: the FPS line at GUI 4, then the position lines at GUI 3
guiscale 4
sleep 3
shot f3p-bar-gui4-fps
guiscale 3
debug pin player_position
sleep 3
shot f3p-bar-pos

# 4. The system lines on the right
debug pin system_specs
sleep 3
shot f3p-bar-specs
set recordCard true
set cardCorner TOP_RIGHT
sleep 3
shot f3p-card-tr-specs
set cardCorner TOP_LEFT

# 5. Many lines
debug pin game_version
debug pin tps
debug pin memory
debug pin player_section_position
debug pin light_levels
debug pin heightmap
debug pin biome
debug pin local_difficulty
debug pin entity_spawn_counts
debug pin sound_mood
debug pin chunk_render_stats
debug pin entity_render_stats
debug pin particle_render_stats
debug pin chunk_source_stats
debug pin chunk_generation_stats
debug pin simple_performance_impactors
sleep 3
shot f3p-many-top
set recordCard false
set barPosition BOTTOM
sleep 3
shot f3p-many-bottom-gui3
resize 1280x720
sleep 3
shot f3p-many-bottom-720
resize 1920x1080
set barPosition TOP
sleep 2

# 6. Every line back as a new player has it
debug unpin fps
debug unpin player_position
debug unpin system_specs
debug unpin game_version
debug unpin tps
debug unpin memory
debug unpin player_section_position
debug unpin light_levels
debug unpin heightmap
debug unpin biome
debug unpin local_difficulty
debug unpin entity_spawn_counts
debug unpin sound_mood
debug unpin chunk_render_stats
debug unpin entity_render_stats
debug unpin particle_render_stats
debug unpin chunk_source_stats
debug unpin chunk_generation_stats
debug unpin simple_performance_impactors
sleep 3
shot f3p-unpinned
music play
